create_train_transform: create a TrainTransform instance with size, max_angle, and crop_scale for training-time image and depth augmentation
apply_train_transform: apply a TrainTransform to an image and depth pair with random crop, flip, color jitter, and rotation
create_base_transform: create a BaseTransform instance with a target size for resizing image and depth pairs
apply_base_transform: apply a BaseTransform to resize an image and depth map to a specified target size
add_gaussian_noise: add Gaussian noise with a given mean and standard deviation to a PyTorch tensor
